semantics.stable_identity_rule: Identity has stable canonical identity independent of credentials, transport sessions and display names.
semantics.approval_rule: Approvals are explicit evidence/state and do not themselves grant unrelated authorization.
semantics.separation_rule: IdentityCore answers who the subject is; IAM assurance answers how strongly that identity was authenticated.
semantics.reset_rule: Creating a new identity creates a separate identity history; it does not merge prior MeritCore histories.

invariants.rule: Identity, portfolio evidence and merit semantics have explicit owners and cannot silently substitute for one another.
